selection.rule: ALL110 raw_native Dice weighted by official ROI voxel count; sort ascending then case_id. Lower central case for even count; sub-01 is fixed continuity. All ten outcomes published. Undefined aggregate/failures remain NA with reasons and are not imputed or silently dropped.
